$comment: The "Built in" list: themes published in tejaswigowda/blog-webCLI-themes, curated by pull request. A theme is a repository; it works by its address (owner/repo[/folder]@tag) whether or not it is listed here. Each entry: name, repo, ref (a release tag or commit), licence, description, screenshot (https).

themes.name: Essay
themes.description: Long-form reading: a serif face, a narrow measure and generous leading.

themes.name: Terminal
themes.description: Monospace, dark by default, with a prompt-style masthead. Follows the system if it prefers light.

themes.name: Paper
themes.description: High-contrast and minimal: system sans-serif, black on white, hard rules, a considered print stylesheet.

themes.name: Cards
themes.description: The post list as a grid of cards; a comfortable single column for reading a post.

themes.name: Twenty Twenty-One
themes.description: Twenty Twenty-One 2.9 from wordpress.org (GPL), CSS only; uses the wordpress-classic markup.
